question: Does a live male P1 network (DA1 / ppk23 / motion still feeding it) treat a frozen grounded Icarus-from-male as a female?
honesty: Published-sign schema. Condition 3 equals 1 when both present the same signed channels into a saturating P1 unit. Not a MaleCNS hop-count.

conditions.name: icarus_from_male
conditions.role: the rule: fat wingless, HD on

conditions.name: icarus_from_male_male_odor
conditions.role: Icarus body, odor still male (cVA on, HD off), free approach

conditions.name: icarus_from_male_odor_only
conditions.role: 7,11-HD without the fat wingless female shape

conditions.name: icarus_from_female
conditions.role: same body+odor as 3, female wiring tag

conditions.name: icarus_pin_male_cuticle
conditions.role: forced contact, Icarus body, male odor, male cuticle
